# 获取人脸亮度
##### 简要描述

- ChannelID代表通道号，对于IPC只有一个通道，使用的时候需替换为数字，取值从1开始

| 字段 | 类型 | 描述 | 是否必须 |
| --- | --- | --- | ---- |
| ChannelID | interger | 通道号<span class="colour" style="color:rgb(85, 85, 85)">，对于IPC只有一个通道，使用的时候需替换为数字，取值从1开始</span> | 是 |
| FaceBrightness | interger | 人脸亮度，[0-100] | 是 |

![image.png](data:image/png;base64,)

```
<span class="colour" style="color: rgb(127, 0, 0);">GET /FaceGroup/1/FaceBrightness HTTP/1.1</span>
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46
User-Agent: PostmanRuntime/7.42.0
Accept: */*
Cache-Control: no-cache
Postman-Token: 78395a9a-43a0-48c7-ac53-f92cca47d800
Host: 192.168.6.150
Accept-Encoding: gzip, deflate, br
Connection: keep-alive


HTTP/1.0 200 OK
Server: CGI/2.0.5
Content-Length:148
Content-Type:application/xml
Connection:close

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" ?>
<FaceGroup Version="1.0">
<ChannelID>1</ChannelID>
<FaceBrightness>50</FaceBrightness>
</FaceGroup>
```

##### 请求URL

 - `/FaceGroup/ChannelID/FaceBrightness` 

##### 请求方式

- get
 
##### 成功返回示例  
```
[]

```
